abstract: Magnetic resonance (MR) imaging was performed in 45 patients with 52 surgically proved ovarian teratomas. MR findings of these tumors were classified into three types depending on the degree of fatty proportions in the tumor. The majority of teratomas were filled with fatty tissue in the cystic cavity (n = 43, 82.7%). In 5 tumors (9.6%), fatty tissue was seen at the edge or within the cyst wall. Fatty tissue could not be seen in any part of the tumor in 4 cases (7.7%). The tumors without a fatty component on MR images tend to have fewer sebaceous glands and less fatty tissue within the cyst wall than tumors with an abundant fatty component. Demonstration of fatty tissue is pathognomonic for these tumors. However, tumors with a small amount of fatty tissue may be indistinguishable from cystic ovarian tumors on MR images.
abstract_ja: 手術で確定した卵巣奇形腫52個（患者45例）について磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を実施した。MRI所見は、腫瘍内の脂肪成分の割合に応じて3型に分類した。大半の腫瘍（43個、82.7%）は嚢胞内腔が脂肪組織で満たされていた。5個（9.6%）では嚢胞壁の辺縁または内部に脂肪組織を認めた。4個（7.7%）では腫瘍のいずれの部分にも脂肪組織を認めなかった。MRIで脂肪成分を認めない腫瘍は、脂肪成分の多い腫瘍に比べて皮脂腺が少なく、嚢胞壁内の脂肪組織も少ない傾向があった。脂肪組織の証明は本腫瘍に特異的な所見である。しかし、脂肪成分の少ない腫瘍は、MRIでは嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍と区別がつかない場合がある。
